_note: Ways to turn site soil into rock. Ranges are (low, high); mor_mpa[0] sizes the wall in rock_options.py. Every value is sourced in 'src' or tagged UNSOURCED/TO-MEASURE. heat_mj_per_kg = fuel energy per kg of product; elec_kwh_per_kg = electricity per kg of product.

compacted_earth.name: compacted stabilized earth (baseline)
notes: not rock: the comparison point

fired_brick_panel_drystack.name: printed fired units, dry-stack + rods
fired_brick_panel_drystack.soils: clayey (15-40% clay), or clay hauled for units only
fired_brick_panel_drystack.rig: clay printer(s) and/or pug mill + die, fibre-hood kiln, casting bed, torque wrench, tilt gear
notes: rho = whole panel incl. husk-filled cells (brick_panel_check.py: ~282 kg per 8x4 ft)
fc = gross masonry f'm; fired clay units themselves 36-46 MPa average
heat per kg of PANEL: fired clay is ~80% of panel mass
hours: firing cycle + assembly; no mortar or grout cure
electricity: printer and pug mill, UNSOURCED

fired_brick_panel_grouted.name: printed fired units, grouted + bars
fired_brick_panel_grouted.soils: clayey (15-40% clay), or clay hauled for units only
fired_brick_panel_grouted.rig: clay printer and/or pug mill + die, fibre-hood kiln, casting bed, tilt gear
notes: ~315 kg per 8x4 ft panel
the grout cure sets the pace (3-28 days by binder)

fired_brick_laid.name: fired solid brick, laid on site
fired_brick_laid.rig: brick molds or press, kiln (hood or built from the first bricks)
notes: MOR = masonry flexural strength across mortar joints (the weak link), not the brick's
slow, skilled laying; confined masonry (tie columns + ring beam) for seismic zones
src: kiln energy PMC11800390: VSBK 0.9, zigzag 1.1, clamp 3.0 MJ/kg

fired_panel.name: fired single-piece ceramic panel
notes: industrial precedent is thin pressed slabs (1.6x3.2 m, 6-20 mm), not thick site clay
big slabs of site clay likely crack in drying and firing; kiln must be panel-sized
src: unit MOR >3.4 MPa well-burned brick (NIST via Masonry Design & Detailing)

melt_cast.name: melted and cast rock
melt_cast.rig: induction or arc furnace, MW-class power
notes: in-situ vitrification: 0.72-1.0 MWh/t, ~3.5 MW, melts take 1-2 years to cool
cast basalt: >=300-450 MPa compressive, >=45 MPa bending
microwave sintering: 69-98 MJ/kg in the lab; lunar results rely on nanophase iron

geopolymer_rock.name: geopolymer (soil + fired clay + activator)
geopolymer_rock.soils: most; clay is the precursor after calcining
notes: soil geopolymer ~9-15 MPa; one-part metakaolin 38.8 MPa at 28 d
activator ~10% of precursor; heat cure raises compressive but cuts flexural 38-45%
MOR range UNSOURCED

cement_concrete.name: concrete (screened site sand/gravel + cement)
cement_concrete.soils: sandy/gravelly only; clay fines must be screened or washed out
notes: 20 MPa needs >=300-400 kg cement/m3 with clean aggregate
clayey soil-cement at 10-14% cement reached only 1.5-3.4 MPa

lime_steam.name: lime-sand/pozzolan, steam cured (no autoclave)
notes: autoclaved sand-lime (170-200 C, 0.85-1.6 MPa steam) reaches ~10-30 MPa but needs a pressure vessel
non-autoclaved strength and all MOR values UNSOURCED

sulfur_concrete.name: sulfur concrete
sulfur_concrete.soils: clean sand only: no swelling clay, absorption <2%
notes: melts at 115-120 C, ignites at 232 C, burns to SO2: not for occupied buildings
sulfur $165-531/t in 2025; plinths, tanks, drains maybe

biocement.name: bio-cemented sandstone (EICP/MICP)
biocement.soils: sands and gravels only (bacteria need >=0.4 um pores)
notes: 8-20% CaCO3 -> 4-10+ MPa; per kg CaCO3: 0.60 kg urea + 1.11 kg CaCl2 in, 1.07 kg NH4Cl out (stoichiometry)
commercial Biolith tile 25 MPa, interior only
MOR UNSOURCED
